title: Buddy Bolden's Funky Butt
summary: Dick Allen asks how Funky Butt went; Barnes cannot recall it.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I was wondering about something else, too. What about this Buddy Bowling, you know, his number, Funky Butt? How did that go? Can you hear me?
I was pushing that. That's the most I can remember of it now.
I saw it. How would Buddy Variant?
Buddy Variant, that was him in there. I was trying to play the drums on the Amite, you see, and kind of be burrowing in there.
But I thought Buddy had some part he played you home for me once.
Well I can't remember the things now.
Yeah, that's too bad. Yeah. Yeah. So getting back to this fellow Kaiser, he played in brass bands too.
